messages.author: 985e455b8390aae3
messages.subject: Site covariates with formatLong
parts:
Hi, all. My first posting here, and I'm just getting started with
unmarked, so please forgive me if this is a very naive question.

I have a total of 3000 observations from 18 sites (~100 to 500 per
site) for a single species, so I'm trying to create my
unmarkedFramePcount using formatLong. However, I am having a hard
time figuring out how to to incorporate site covariates into this
unmarked frame. I'm starting with:

counts<-formatLong(data, type=unmarkedFramePCount)#Convert data to
unmarked frame

...but once it's in a umf format, how can I append siteCovs?

I tried including columns in my input data frame, but when I try to
reference them in a model after the second tilde, I get "object '[site
cov]' not found", and formatLong documentation says all additional
columns are observation covariates. By the way, all of my site
covariates are categorical/factors, if that matters.

Thanks in advance for any help.

Shane Siers
Graduate Student
Colorado State University

messages.author: 9548b9e0c8258268
messages.subject: Re: Site covariates with formatLong
parts:
Hi Shane,

If you have a data frame with a row for each site, say my.site.covs, then you can just do this:

siteCovs(counts) <- my.site.covs


Hope that helps,
Ian
